prompt: Create a polished realistic illustrated miniature for our scientific chart. Isolated complete object on genuinely transparent square background, no ground, no space/stars backdrop, no labels, no cast shadow. Subject 94% of square's longest dimension, 3% clear margins. Soft studio key from screen UPPER LEFT/NW, smoothly darker lower-right, enough fill to read whole silhouette. Restrained natural palette and fine readable detail. Artist interpretation of WASP-39 b: puffy spherical warm gas giant with tan, muted orange and cream cloud bands and subtle turbulence. Soft atmospheric edge. White sphere reference controls illumination only.
note: Interpretive illustration. Mission photos constrain observed shapes; unresolved and unlit detail is inferred. Exoplanets and Psyche are artist interpretations, not resolved photographs.

provenance.description: Generated illustration, not a resolved photograph. Geographic outlines or artistic references may constrain the design.

lighting.prompt: Edit this wasp-39-b artist illustration into an UNSHADED ALBEDO DISC for later multiplication with our standard white sphere lighting template. Preserve its distinctive surface/cloud patterns and color palette. Remove ALL directional illumination, all dark right/lower hemisphere shading, bright left highlights and rim glow. Uniform ambient exposure edge to edge, including right and bottom. Keep spherical projected texture foreshortening but no globe lighting gradient: a perfectly circular flat color-texture disc with a crisp alpha edge. Center 94% square, transparent background, no shadow outside.
